about: Rows a dated surface series can be built from. A new source is a new row (URL template, index names, mapping), never a new code path. {cycle} is the forecast cycle, {valid} the record's valid time, {lead} the hours between them.

rows.description: NCEP GDAS 0.25 degree analysis at each record's valid time (hindcast: the analysed SST and sea ice the forecast period actually had).

NCEP GFS 0.25 degree forecast from ONE cycle at each record's lead (forecast mode: the SST and sea ice GFS itself carries, which is its analysed anomaly relaxed toward climatology, so no information after the cycle enters).
